summary: Tests-only red-phase draft for issue #39. Added (1) SolverParityCorpusTests — a solver-parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests that loads a committed corpus fixture (ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/solver-parity-corpus.json, provenance viamin/color_matching#111) and asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match expected outputs exactly, including earliest-wins tie cases, exclusion policy, zero-weight channel handling, and end-to-end CompositionSolver fast-path parity; (2) OpenAPIContractTests — guards the vendored OpenAPI document (Fixtures/openapi.json, provenance viamin/color_matching#110) against drift from the /api/v1 wire contract decoded by APIModels.swift/PaletteAPIClient; (3) PaletteAPIClientMigrationTests — behavior pins (endpoint paths, printer_profile_id query, Accept header, token handling, envelope decoding incl. absent-not-zero responses, 401/badStatus/malformedResponse mapping) that must survive the generated-client migration. Red failures are expected and by design: neither the parity corpus nor the OpenAPI spec is committed yet (both are upstream dependencies viamin/color_matching#111 and #110). ENVIRONMENT LIMITATION: this Linux container has no Swift toolchain and ColorComposerCore targets macOS (CoreGraphics), so `swift test` could not be executed here; bin/lint runs and exits 0 (self-skips the build). Test results below are by static inspection against the verified public API surface, not execution — run `cd ColorComposerCore && swift test` on a macOS host with Xcode 16. Corpus schema and refresh workflow documented in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md (README.md is outside the test-phase allowlist; fold/link it during the implementation run).
